data.title: Humanoid robot shoves 77-pound load, lifts 44 pounds in new demo
data.description: KAIST's Humanoid v0.9 pushes 77.2-pound loads and lifts 44.1 pounds using visual feedback and learning-based control.
data.author: Jijo Malayil
data.keywords: Dynamic Robot Control & Design Laboratory, Humanoid, Humanoid v0.9, KAIST, Korea, Robot Model, Robot Training, Robotics
